pr_title: fix: Fix incorrect lazy schema for explode on array columns
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/19763

Our lazy schema for an exploded array column was not correct. I think this was only starting causing issues with joins after https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/pull/19625 because we never used this schema information before then

issue_context.title: `join` fails because of an uninstructed cast from int to array[int, x] on 1.14.0
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

```python
import polars as pl
import numpy as np

dtype = [("id", "<i4")]
data = np.array([[(1,), (2,)]], dtype=dtype)

df = pl.LazyFrame(data).explode(pl.col("*"))

other_df = pl.LazyFrame({"node": [1]})

result = df.join(other_df, left_on="id", right_on="node").collect()

print(result)
```

### Log output

_No response_

### Issue description

When joining two LazyFrames, one constructed from a numpy structured array, and then exploded, the schema reflects the change, but during a join operation this still goes wrong.

The state of the two LazyFrames before the join:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/442cfc7d-050a-4815-bb35-351f65077bcf)

The error of the join:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/db475d60-8e73-4814-84ee-7f57f4012ffb)

This error also occurs when optimizations are turned off:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/37d2530a-dc89-44fa-8ded-482cb04f540b)

Explicitly casting the columns to int32 before the operation seems to work:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/51d83646-db22-4cac-8d72-fbe1c745890a)

### Expected behavior

I expect the data type to not be an array, and the join to succeed.
